review_evidence: README describes an incomplete chess implementation in Lean whose examples prove concrete forced wins/mates.
Five of 12 Lean files contain 18 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Chess/Examples.lean and TacticsTest.lean include named forced-win results such as back-rank, promotion, smothered-mate and en-passant mate positions, so the source contains searchable formal game specifications/proofs.
summary: Reviewed Chess.lean; retain the chess-state formalization, forced-win semantics, tactics, and checked mating examples.
